question.text: Under SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations 2020, the MINIMUM net worth requirement for a Portfolio Manager is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations 2020, a portfolio manager must have a minimum net worth of Rs. 5 crore and must maintain this specified net worth at all times. The Trap: The other options do not match the prescribed PM net worth. Note: The portfolio manager must furnish a chartered accountant's net worth certificate as and when required by SEBI.
